text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I won't lose like I did before. I'm a completely different Umamusume today!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: My hair's got the right amount of volume, and the ends are just right.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Not only that, I've got my sparkling smile and my pose on point.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: In any case, I'm shining more today than I was yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah! This is the real me! I'm gonna look super cute and get the win today!
